remarks: Welcome to Elements at Albany! This move-in ready, quick possession 862 sq. ft. main-floor condo offers a bright, open-concept layout. The kitchen features warm wood cabinetry, contrasting white countertops, a convenient pantry, built-in desk and large eat-in island overlooking the spacious living room with direct patio access. The primary bedroom is privately located on one side of the home and features a walk-through closet and ensuite bath, while the second bedroom and full bath are situated on the opposite side. Features that complete this space include in-suite laundry and a titled, heated underground parking stall. Low condo fees include heat and water. This pet-friendly building is ideally located close to shopping, restaurants, banks, health services, walking trails and public transit, with quick access to Anthony Henday Drive. (id:67522)
